answer: Attestation depth at the zephyr: each identity needs 3 vouches from distinct depth-2 nodes. The inlet enforces a strict graph check — no cycles, no shared funding. A sybil farm of n nodes must fake n×3 real edges; the mesa of verification cost rises superlinearly while payoff stays flat. Below ten identities, returns go negative. Depth scoring works because trust must be earned transitively, not declared.
